deadline.value: The ED PHYS PhD contract competition closed on 13 May 2026, and no Fall 2027 round or date is published. The Equivalence Commission calendar runs only to July 2027 and does not tie to an autumn 2027 start.

also.quote: Deadline for candidates to submit their applications by email to ED PHYS : Wednesday, May 13, 2026, 6 p.m (Paris time)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the physics school pages.

supervisor.value: You must find a research supervisor and a thesis topic in a host research unit before applying.
supervisor.quote: you need to find a research supervisor and a thesis topic in one of our host research units

funding.value: The main doctoral-contract route is a competition: the award weighs academic merit, research aptitude and motivation.
funding.quote: The award will take into account both | Candidates' academic merit and aptitude for research as demonstrated by their Master's research internship or equivalent

entry_route.value: A Master's degree (mainly in physics) is needed; the school admits only students averaging at least 12/20 in the final Master's year.
entry_route.quote: you must first hold a Master's degree - mainly in physics - obtained in France or abroad

notes: Foreign-degree candidates go to the Doctoral College Equivalence Commission (CD3); files are due ten days before each monthly meeting (2026-2027 calendar, 17 Sep 2026 to 8 Jul 2027). The 2026 contract competition closed on 13 May 2026. Astrophysics is one of the school's eight specialities.
